en: Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (*anāsava*) and not accompanied by a root (*ahetuka*), a state that is conflict-free (*anāsava*) and accompanied by a root arises by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and not accompanied by a root, a state that is with-conflict (*sāsava*) and accompanied by a root arises by way of the root-condition.

(Abbreviated. There are two [answers] for the root [condition] ... [and so on] ... one for the prenascence and repetition conditions ... one for the result condition ... two for the non-disappearance condition.
Dependent on a non-conflictive, rootless state, a non-conflictive, rootless state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-non-conflictive, rootless state, a non-conflictive, rootless state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root [condition] there are two; under object, one … pe … under conascence, four … pe … under resultant, one … pe … under non-disappearance, four.
